copy.text: 1  Copy the design-system files to your computer
Codex will download and save a local copy for you.

You’ll need to copy the design-system files onto your computer and save them in a folder. This is called cloning the repository.

Choose somewhere easy to remember, such as a folder called Code. Codex will save the files in a design-system folder inside it: Code/design-system.

You won’t do your project work in this folder. We’ll create a separate folder for that in the next step.

In Codex, start a local chat with access to your chosen location and paste this request:
Codex confirms where it saved the design-system files and reports any missing tools or access. Keep that folder location handy for the next step.
